name: PixelExperience-12.0
author: @tlas01
changelog: Rebranded to RM6785 (Supported devices: Realme 6, 6i(Indian), 6s and Realme 7, Narzo 20 Pro, Narzo 30 4G)
Custom vendor and kernel built from source
notes: This ROM does not contain recovery so if you are flashing from rmui 2 no problem,you can proceed as usual. But If we are flashing from RMUI 1.0 then you have to boot to bootloader by adb command Then install recovery.
